documentation.content:
One or more held symbols have been in FC-029 R3 drawdown pause for >= the alert threshold (default 7 trading days). The bot is not writing covered calls on them, so that capital is idle.

Precedent: AMZN's 62-day implicit pause (Feb-Apr 2026) cost an estimated $1,500-3,000 in foregone premium.

The alert message lists each symbol with days paused and depth below the assignment strike. Full detail on the Bot Health page's drawdown-pause card.

This filter also matches DRAWDOWN_PAUSE_ALERT_CHECK_FAILED - the daily check could not evaluate pause state (live-positions proxy down). Treat that as 'unknown', not 'all clear'.

Runbook: deploy/monitoring/drawdown_pause_alert.md

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-dashboard" AND severity>=WARNING AND textPayload:"DRAWDOWN_PAUSE_ALERT"
